explanations.30: This stores the device's acceleration from the last motion event; we need to remember it so we can compare it to the next sample to detect sudden changes (shakes).
explanations.55: The `?.` operator means 'call vibrate only if it exists', since some browsers don't support haptic feedback; the `[40, 30, 40]` are millisecond durations for vibration pulses.
explanations.111: This effect runs `clearTimers` once when the component unmounts to prevent timer leaks; the empty dependency array means it only runs on mount/unmount, not on every render.
